name: Potassium nitrite
digestion_absorption: Readily absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract.
metabolism: Participates in nitrate-nitrite-nitric oxide pathways; nitrosation can occur under some conditions.
potential_effects: Technological benefit includes botulinal control; risk assessment considers methemoglobinemia and endogenous N-nitroso compound formation.
human_evidence: Processed-meat epidemiology is not additive-specific and includes multiple co-exposures.
efsa_assessment: Use latest EFSA nitrite/nitrate re-evaluation and exposure assessments.
jecfa_assessment: JECFA ADI applies; verify current database entry and monograph.
notes: Do not reduce to 'good/bad'; separate benefit, dose, exposure, context and evidence strength.

name: Aspartame
digestion_absorption: Hydrolyzed in the gut to constituent amino acids and methanol.
metabolism: Constituents enter normal metabolic pathways; phenylalanine is important for people with PKU.
potential_effects: Assessments distinguish hazard identification from dietary risk at actual exposure; PKU labelling is essential.
human_evidence: Large evidence base; conclusions should be tied to authority/date and dose.
jecfa_assessment: JECFA reaffirmed ADI 0-40 mg/kg bw/day in 2023.
eu_regulatory_note: Phenylalanine-related labelling applies under EU rules.
